summary: Own CSF file loading and pass raw scale planes to B12X preparation
compatibility: Install the paired vLLM/B12X CSF preparation changes. Canonical CSF checkpoint files and launch commands remain compatible.
details: vLLM owns CSF manifests, model inventories, shard lifetimes, TP slicing and expert assembly.
The quantization method supplies CsfScalePlanes to the standard B12X prepare_weights API; vLLM does not construct kernel-specific GPU scale batches.
Canonical checkpoint schemas, native tensor precision and launch flags are unchanged.
